name: Vector Shifting
goal: Remember where the token starts, follow the arrows in your mind, and tap where it ends.
tip: Keep a finger-point in your mind's eye and move it with each arrow. Do not try to remember all the arrows, only where the token is now.
voice: Look where the token starts. Then it hides.
Arrows will show one at a time. Move the token in your mind with each arrow.
An arrow with times two means two steps.
At the end, tap the square where the token is now.
